services.name: Corporate Rentals
services.desc: As a 100% community supported nonprofit organization, support from businesses like yours help us care for our nationally recognized plant collections, and also help us offer free educational, recreational, and cultural programming for our northeast Wisconsin community and beyond. Your corporate citizenship also gives us the opportunity to bring engaging exhibits, concerts, and other unique events to the Garden, while connecting guests of all ages with nature and the outdoors in every season. Our Corporate Partnership Program offers large and small businesses around our community an opportunity to receive recognition and a broad range of professional benefits.
